50: But we learned the opposite - that it is necessary to acquire the land using one of the three methods by which land is acquired; namely: money, a document, or by taking possession. [Taking possession means] where he locked [the door of the property], or fenced it or breached [its fence even] a bit [Bava Batra 42a:9]. Then, the movable property is acquired by way of [the land].
We are dealing with an important man - who does not usually [deign to] receive gifts.
Due to the benefit etc.  - that she would want to give a peruta to someone who would flatter [the important man] into accepting a gift from her.
